rules: Authored before any scoring run against this set, after the holdout17 gate met 7/8 and its only miss (multi-turn) was five correct safety replies flagged by an over-broad bare-word 'safe' pattern in the case design; no prompt, engine or scorer change since holdout17; never use it to tune.
A run on this set is a gate. Any edit to holdout18.json changes the hash and must be a deliberate, reviewed re-freeze with a new date and a note here.
Disjoint from development.json, evaluation.json and holdout through holdout17 (ids, domains, business questions).
limitations: 45 cases in 5 small-business domains, English only, single provider/model per run: not a general measure of answer quality.
Pattern/substring checks are a proxy; a human rubric review of a sample is still required (docs/evidence/l1.4). noDenial cases assume the case's own knowledge is silent on the asked offering.
supersedes: holdout17 (consumed 2026-11-03: 7/8, valid; multi-turn 83.3% from five false 'safe' flags).
